title: 29章：妖祸如潮古城出
content_zh:
还有一点，是边关月没有告诉张荼的。

    那便是妖族的来历，天地阴阳之归属。人世间是为阳间，那么妖域自然为阴间。所以阴阳相互融合之时，天地才会骤然扩大，妖域多为虚境，受到阳间的影响，大部分化作了实体，可是仍有广袤的地域化作云烟。

    阴阳相融，对于人世间是一场大劫，可是对于妖域又何尝不是，如今一体两面的两个世界融合在即，人世间不断地扩大，妖域却是不断地缩小，甚至有着大片的疆域径直消失。

    而随着天空之中的黑云愈加的凝实，地星之上却是亮起了星星点点的光芒。

    西亳、雍城、大兴、长安、京城、平遥、金陵、殷墟、襄阳、锦州、冀州、蓟州、徽州、大同、建水……

    马丘比丘、奇琴伊察、玛拉蒂卡尔、梅萨维德、吴哥、克泰西封、佩特拉、巴布韦、巴格尔核、阿尼城、波利斯、帕伦克……

    一座座曾经因为各种各样的原因消散于历史长河，抑或者在现在又迸发出别样光辉的城池，在这一日，在这在一天天变之时，再一次的绽放出超乎世人想象的力量。

    例如西亳，商三亳之一。

    西亳为五帝时期帝喾的都城 ，商朝的立国之都。在推翻夏后氏的统治之后，成汤在夏都斟鄩附近另建新都，称西亳。

    商代中期，商王盘庚亦是迁殷前曾“从先王居”定都西亳。

    这本已经化作了一捧废墟的城池，却是从岁月中径直走出，绽放着悠悠光华，吸引着流离失所的众人前来避难，那悠悠光华，不仅隔绝了黑暗，亦是带来了生存的希望，带来了家的安定。

    在历史长河的画卷之中，有着太多的辉煌，可是这些辉煌，都在岁月力量面前所有所暗淡，但是这些，是一种无形的存在，虽然我们看不到历史中的辉煌，但他们都的的确确存在过，所以才有了我们，我们要带着这种力量来生活。

    而那千百年的源源不断的祭祀，看似是我们在祭祀祖先，其实是我们去寻求遗失在历史长河中的力量。

    每一次祭祀，都会带给我们所祭祀之人或物一份力量，而今天的异变，正是反哺之时，这世界，从来没有一个独立的人，因为任何一个人都是有根的，哪怕你看不到，这个根也依旧存在。

    或许以往不信，但是看到那一座座无中生有荧荧城池，没有人会选择不相信。

    而也正是在这一日，阴阳两面正式看是交错，就像是两本相合的书籍，有着太多的交集点，而这些交集点，则是化作了一个个的空间溶洞，从中所涌出的，是无尽的天地灵力，以及那数量足以触目惊心的妖族。

    这波澜壮阔的大世，张荼无力也无心去庇护太多人，在天变伊始，张荼便是带着一干人等加快了众人入驻的速度。

    而当城门缓缓闭合之时，便是有一个虚幻的虫洞出现在了王庄上空，站在城楼上遥遥望去，就像是一个怪异的嘴巴，开合之间，便是吐出数十头妖兽。

    而今妖祸，更胜以往的天灾，新时代的安定生活，早已经弱化了齐国人骨子里的求生本能，护国军无微不至的呵护，使得他们放弃了关于生存的担忧，而这一切，在太平盛世之中是那么的理所当然，可是这乱世之中，太多的人，为了这种懈怠付出了惨重的代价。
content_en:
There is another point that Bian Guanyue did not tell Zhang Tu.

    That is the origin of the demon clan and the belonging of yin and yang in the world. The human world is the yang world, so the demon realm is naturally the underworld. Therefore, when yin and yang merge with each other, the world will suddenly expand. Most of the demon realm is a virtual realm. Affected by the yang world, most of them have turned into entities, but there are still vast areas that have turned into clouds and smoke.

    The fusion of yin and yang is a catastrophe for the human world, but it is not the same for the demon realm. Now the two worlds with two sides of the same body are merging. The human world is constantly expanding, but the demon realm is constantly shrinking, and even large areas have disappeared.

    And as the black clouds in the sky became more solid, little stars lit up above the stars.

    Xibo, Yongcheng, Daxing, Chang'an, Jingcheng, Pingyao, Jinling, Yinxu, Xiangyang, Jinzhou, Jizhou, Jizhou, Huizhou, Datong, Jianshui...

    Machu Picchu, Chichen Itza, Maratikal, Mesa Verde, Angkor, Ctesiphon, Petra, Bubwe, Baghel Core, Ani City, Polis, Palenque...

    Cities that once disappeared in the long river of history for various reasons, or now burst out with a different kind of brilliance, on this day, in this day-by-day change, once again bloomed with power beyond the imagination of the world.

    For example, Xibo is one of the three Shang Bos.

    Xibo was the capital of Emperor Ku during the Five Emperors period and the founding capital of the Shang Dynasty. After overthrowing the rule of the Xia Hou family, Cheng Tang built a new capital near the Xia capital, Zhenbo, called Xibo.

    In the middle of the Shang Dynasty, Shang King Pan Geng also made his capital Xibo "from the residence of the previous king" before moving to Yin.

    This city, which had been turned into a bunch of ruins, has stepped out of the years, blooming with a long brilliance, attracting displaced people to take refuge. The long brilliance not only isolates the darkness, but also brings hope of survival and stability of home.

    In the long scroll of history, there are too many glories, but these glories have all been dimmed in the face of the power of time. However, these are an invisible existence. Although we cannot see the glories in history, they have indeed existed. That is why we exist, and we must live with this power.

    And those thousands of years of continuous sacrifices seem to be us worshiping our ancestors, but in fact they are us seeking the power lost in the long river of history.

    Every sacrifice brings strength to the person or thing we sacrifice, and today's changes are the time to feed back. There has never been an independent person in this world, because everyone has roots. Even if you can't see it, this root still exists.

    Maybe you didn't believe it in the past, but no one would choose not to believe it when they saw the Yingying cities that were created out of nothing.

    And it was also on this day that the two sides of yin and yang were officially intertwined, like two books that overlapped, with too many intersections, and these intersections turned into space caves, from which poured out endless spiritual power of heaven and earth, as well as a shocking number of monsters.

    In this magnificent world, Zhang Tu was unable and unwilling to protect too many people. At the beginning of the natural change, Zhang Tu led a group of people to speed up the move in.

    And when the city gate slowly closed, an illusory wormhole appeared in the sky above Wangzhuang. Looking from a distance from the city tower, it looked like a weird mouth that spit out dozens of monsters between opening and closing.

    Nowadays, demonic disasters are worse than natural disasters in the past. The stable life in the new era has already weakened the survival instinct of the Qi people. The meticulous care of the National Guard Army has made them give up worries about survival. All of this is so natural in peaceful and prosperous times, but in these troubled times, too many people have paid a heavy price for this slackness.
title_en: Chapter 29: Demonic disasters appear in the ancient city
